<thought>From the mass spectrum the monoisotopic mass is 114.06808 Da, which matches the formula C₆H₁₀O₂ (exact mass 114.06808). This formula has a DBE of 2, consistent with a cyclic ester (lactone) such as ε‑caprolactone. The most plausible structure is the six‑membered lactone ε‑caprolactone, whose SMILES is “O=C1OCCCC1”.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C1OCCCC1</final_answer>
